title: 写实卧室生活抓拍
description: 一个为 Seedance 2.5 设计的多镜头视频提示词，展示了一位年轻女性在卧室放松、与手机和猫互动的场景，包含详细的镜头描述和对话。
positivePrompt:
创作一段 30 秒超写实的多镜头生活抓拍视频，展示一位年轻韩国女性在卧室自然放松的状态。请使用多个不同的镜头和拍摄角度，而非单一的长镜头。画面应呈现出一种无意间捕捉到的真实生活瞬间。

风格：
手持纪录片式的写实感，不完美的构图，轻微的镜头晃动，柔和的曝光呼吸感，自动对焦略有延迟，真实的皮肤质感，柔和的室内自然光以及浅景深。包含自然的眨眼、呼吸、身体动作和克制的真实表情。避免摆拍、商业广告的精致感或电影级的完美感。

主体：
一位 20 出头、长发、自然美的韩国女性。身穿配套的纯棉睡衣套装：圆领无袖上衣和宽松短裤。赤脚，淡妆，皮肤质感真实。

场景：
一间充满生活气息、略显凌乱的卧室，有未整理的床铺、柔软的被褥和日常个人物品。她趴在床上浏览黑色智能手机上的购物页面。一只家猫与她自然互动。

镜头 1 — 0–4 秒：
她趴在床上，随意地浏览购物页面。她微微皱眉，用韩语嘟囔道：“아, 뭐 살랬더라...” (“啊……我刚才要买什么来着？”)。自然的韩语口型同步。她的赤脚在身后轻轻摆动。低位手持摄像机在床垫旁平滑移动。

镜头 2 — 4–8 秒：
一只家猫跳上床，压陷了毯子，向她的手臂走去。猫发出了一声自然的叫声。摄像机随之轻微晃动，随后重新构图，对准她的脸部、手部和猫。

镜头 3 — 8–12 秒：
她转向猫，轻轻抚摸它的额头到肩膀。她深情地说：“우리 애기 왔어?” (“我的小宝贝来了？”)。精准的口型同步。摄像机穿过前景中模糊的猫身，推进至特写。

镜头 4 — 12–16 秒：
她的朋友打来电话，铃声响起。她低头查看来电，滑动接听并将手机贴在耳边。摄像机从略微倾斜的俯视角度进行松散的半圆运动。

镜头 5 — 16–21 秒：
朋友在电话那头说话。她听着，表情困惑，随后回应：“어, 왜? 진짜 거짓말!” (“嗯？为什么？不会吧，你在开玩笑吧。”)。她随即爆发出真诚的笑声。猫在她身旁的毯子上踩奶。侧面手持特写镜头捕捉她的侧脸和手机。

镜头 6 — 21–25 秒：
清脆的门铃声打断了她的笑声。她和猫同时转向卧室门。她停顿了一下，意识到外卖到了，单手撑在床垫上准备起身。摄像机反应略有延迟，随后跟上她的动作。

镜头 7 — 25–30 秒：
她依然拿着手机，用韩语说道：“어, 나 밥 왔다. 끊어.” (“哦，我的饭到了。挂了。”)。她挂断电话，下床走向门口。猫跟在她身后穿过毯子。随着她站起，摄像机向上倾斜，最后以自然的手持跟拍镜头结束，画面指向门口。

音频：
无音乐
originalPrompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic multi-shot candid observational video of a young Korean woman relaxing naturally in her bedroom. Use multiple distinct shots and camera angles, not a single continuous take. The footage should feel like an accidentally captured real-life moment.

STYLE:
Handheld documentary realism, imperfect framing, subtle camera shake, gentle exposure breathing, autofocus settling slightly late, realistic skin texture, soft natural indoor light and shallow depth of field. Natural blinking, breathing, body movement and restrained authentic expressions. No posing, glossy commercial look or cinematic perfection.

SUBJECT:
A naturally beautiful young Korean woman in her early 20s with long dark hair. She wears a matching cotton pajama set: scoop-neck sleeveless top and loose shorts. Barefoot, minimal makeup, realistic skin texture.

SETTING:
A lived-in, slightly messy bedroom with an unmade bed, soft bedding and everyday personal belongings. She relaxes on her stomach across the bed while browsing a shopping page on a black smartphone. A house cat interacts naturally with her.

SHOT 1 — 0–4s:
She lies on her stomach, casually scrolling through a shopping page. She frowns slightly, then mutters in Korean: "아, 뭐 살랬더라..." ("Ah... what was I going to buy again?"). Natural Korean lip sync. Her bare feet gently sway behind her. A low handheld camera glides beside the mattress.

SHOT 2 — 4–8s:
A house cat jumps onto the bed, compressing the blanket and walking toward her arm. It gives one natural meow. The camera reacts with a tiny jolt, then reframes toward her face, hands and cat.

SHOT 3 — 8–12s:
She turns toward the cat and gently strokes it from forehead to shoulders. She affectionately says: "우리 애기 왔어?" ("Did my baby come?"). Accurate lip sync. The camera pushes closer through the cat's softly blurred foreground.

SHOT 4 — 12–16s:
Her friend's ringtone sounds. She looks down, checks the caller, swipes to answer and brings the phone to her ear. The camera makes a loose semicircular movement from a slightly tilted overhead angle.

SHOT 5 — 16–21s:
Her friend talks. She listens with a confused expression, then reacts: "어, 왜? 진짜 거짓말!" ("Huh? Why? No way, you're kidding."). She immediately bursts into genuine laughter. The cat kneads the blanket beside her. A close handheld side angle captures her profile and phone.

SHOT 6 — 21–25s:
A clear doorbell interrupts her laughter. She and the cat turn toward the bedroom door. She pauses, realizing her food has arrived, braces one hand on the mattress and begins getting up. The camera reacts slightly late before correcting back to her movement.

SHOT 7 — 25–30s:
Still holding the phone, she says in Korean: "어, 나 밥 왔다. 끊어." ("Oh, my food's here. I'll hang up."). She ends the call, gets off the bed and walks toward the door. The cat follows across the blankets. The camera tilts upward as she stands, ending with a natural handheld follow toward the doorway.

title: 带有微表情的电影感角色独白
description: 一份用于生成 20 秒电影感女性独白视频的综合提示词。包含关于角色一致性、灯光以及通过微表情展现复杂情感演变的详细说明。
positivePrompt:
根据上传的角色参考图，生成一段 20 秒的电影感独白视频。角色必须严格保持参考图中成年女性的外观：五官、脸型、肤色、黑色长卷发、红唇妆容、黑色单肩礼服、珍珠项链以及整体复古优雅的造型。不得改变其身份、发型或服装。避免使用大众化的 AI 脸或面部畸变。

场景：保持复古室内氛围。角色坐在复古沙发上，右侧有一盏暖黄色台灯。背景昏暗、安静、低饱和度，带有暖棕色和暗金色调。呈现电影般的深夜独白质感。聚焦于面部和上半身，浅景深，轻微胶片颗粒感，柔和的侧光。

情感状态：非悲伤或愤怒，而是经历过后的“超脱”。疲惫、清醒、平静，略带自嘲但坚定。表情是关键：通过眼神、呼吸、缓慢眨眼和细微的唇部动作来传达。就像一个爱过、失望过，如今已无话可说的人。

台词（自然中文，缓慢且富有情感）：
“过去、现在，以及未来，我都不会为了钱出卖我的爱，更不会出卖我的灵魂。我依然相信爱情，我依然判断力不足，我依然缺乏智慧。但我相信法律，我相信善良，我相信终将到来的公正与公平。时间会证明一切。”

镜头拆解：
0-3 秒：静止 0.5 秒开始。目光向下前方，陷入回忆。吸气，缓慢抬头。开始：“过去、现在，以及未来……”伴随停顿。眼神平静且疲惫。
3-6 秒：“……更不会出卖我的灵魂。”说到“灵魂”时直视镜头，放慢语速。嘴唇轻微抿动。眨眼一次。
6-10 秒：“我依然相信爱情……”说到“爱情”时眼神柔和。“……判断力不足”时苦笑并低头。“……缺乏智慧”时呼气并向下看。没有哭泣，只是平静的承认。
10-15 秒：重新看向镜头。“但我相信法律……”情感从无助转为坚定。说到“法律”时目光稳定。不要有宣言式的表演，只需安静的笃定。
15-20 秒：“时间……会证明一切。”在“时间”前停顿 0.8 秒。缓慢说话。结束后静止 1.5 秒。眼神柔和。流露出释然的微笑。看向远方。呼气。镜头缓慢后拉。淡出。

音频：成年女性中文配音，自然、低沉、缓慢、温柔且清晰。不要有播音腔或夸张的哭腔。略带疲惫感或沙哑感。

要求：严格的角色一致性（五官、发型、服装）。电影级质感。缓慢的镜头运动。避免：面部漂移、换脸、手指变形、口型对不上或表演痕迹过重。
originalPrompt:
参考上传人物图片生成一段约20秒的电影感人物独白视频。人物必须严格以参考图中的成年女性为唯一人物参考，完整保持她的五官、脸型、肤色、黑色长卷发、红唇妆容、黑色单肩礼服、珍珠项链以及整体复古贵气造型，不改变人物身份，不更换发型和服装，不生成其他女性，不要AI网红脸，不要五官漂移。

场景也尽量延续参考图的复古室内氛围：人物坐在复古沙发上，右侧保留暖黄色复古台灯，背景昏暗、安静、低饱和，暖棕色与暗金色调。整体像老电影中的深夜独白，画面高级、克制、安静。镜头以人物脸部和上半身为核心，浅景深，轻微胶片颗粒，柔和侧光打在脸上。

人物的核心状态不是悲伤痛哭，也不是愤怒控诉，而是经历过很多事情以后真正“看淡了”的感觉：疲惫、清醒、从容、略带自嘲，但内心仍然坚定。表情尤其重要，要通过眼神、呼吸、慢眨眼、嘴角细微变化表现情绪。像一个曾经认真爱过、失望过，现在已经不想解释，也不再争辩的人。

人物使用自然普通话，缓慢、有感情地念出以下内容：

“我过去，现在，未来，都不会为钱出卖我的爱情，更不会出卖我的灵魂。

我依然相信爱情，我依然眼光不行，我依然智慧欠奉。

但我相信法律，相信善良，相信终究会有的正义和公平。

时间会证明一切。”

0-3秒：
保持参考图中的坐姿和人物造型。开场先安静约0.5秒，没有马上讲话。人物视线没有直视镜头，而是轻轻看向前方偏下的位置，像是在想起过去的事情。轻轻吸气，然后缓慢抬眼。
开始说：“我过去，现在，未来，都不会为钱出卖我的爱情……”

“过去、现在、未来”之间稍微留一点停顿。

表情非常平静，眼神里有疲惫，但没有委屈，没有控诉。说到“爱情”时，目光短暂移开，像是不愿再回忆太多。

3-6秒：
继续缓慢说：

“更不会出卖我的灵魂。”
说到“更不会”时重新抬眼直视镜头。

“灵魂”两个字明显放慢一点，说完停顿约0.5秒。

人物嘴角轻轻抿一下，眼神稳定而坚定。不要皱眉，不要咬牙，不要激动，而是一种“这件事情我早就想清楚了”的状态。

说完后视线轻轻移向旁边，缓慢眨一次眼。

6-10秒：
说：

“我依然相信爱情，我依然眼光不行，我依然智慧欠奉。”

这是整段最重要的微表情段落。
说“我依然相信爱情”时，眼神短暂变柔，嘴角非常轻微上扬，像是心里依旧保留着一点温柔。

说“我依然眼光不行”时，人物轻轻低头，嘴角出现非常淡的苦笑，像是在笑自己。

说“我依然智慧欠奉”时，轻轻呼出一口气，眼神微微向下，带着一点自嘲和无奈。

这里不要哭。

不要表现成受害者。

更像是在坦然承认：“可能我确实看错过人。”

10-15秒：
人物慢慢重新抬头看向镜头，说：

“但我相信法律，相信善良，相信终究会有的正义和公平。”

从“但我相信”开始，人物情绪从无奈慢慢转为平静而坚定。

说“法律”时，眼神稳定。
说“善良”时，表情稍微柔和。

说到“正义和公平”时持续直视镜头，声音不需要变大，但语气比前面更加确定。

不要演成宣言。

不要激昂。

而是一种经历很多之后依然选择相信这些东西的坚定。

眼神传递的是：

“我已经不想争了。”

“结果交给时间。”

15-20秒：
说最后一句：

“时间会证明一切。”

说“时间”之前停顿约0.8秒。

人物先看着镜头，然后非常缓慢地说：

“时间……会证明一切。”
每个字都比前面稍慢。

说完之后不要马上切镜。

保持沉默约1.5秒。

人物继续看着镜头几秒，随后缓慢眨一次眼，眼神逐渐从锐利变得柔和。

嘴角出现一丝几乎看不出来的释然浅笑。

最后视线缓慢移向远处，不再看镜头。

非常轻地呼出一口气。

镜头极缓慢后退。

人物安静坐在沙发上，暖黄色台灯依旧亮着。

最后自然淡出。

声音要求：
成年女性普通话，自然、真实、偏低声线，语速偏慢，声音轻柔但清晰。不要播音腔，不要朗诵，不要电视剧式哭腔。声音可以略带一点疲惫 and 轻微沙哑感，像深夜一个人平静地说出心里话。

情绪曲线：
开始：平静、疲惫
中间：温柔 → 自嘲 → 无奈
后段：清醒、坚定
结尾：释然、看淡

表情要求：
表情必须极其细腻自然。大量使用眼神变化而不是大幅面部动作。偶尔缓慢眨眼、轻轻抿嘴、短暂移开视线、极浅的苦笑、轻微呼气。不要流泪，不要红眼，不要歇斯底里，不要皱眉控诉，不要明显悲伤。

最重要的感觉是：

她不是原谅了谁，也不是还在等待谁。

只是经历过以后，已经不再执着于解释。
有一种“该说的我已经说完，剩下的交给时间”的平静。

画面要求：
严格保持参考人物的一致性，五官稳定，脸型稳定，发型稳定，珍珠项链稳定，黑色单肩礼服稳定。保留复古沙发和右侧暖黄色台灯。电影级写实质感，浅景深，暖棕暗金色调，低饱和，柔和侧光，真实皮肤纹理，轻微胶片颗粒。
镜头运动极慢，以固定镜头、非常轻微推近和最后缓慢拉远为主。不要频繁切镜，不要夸张运镜，不要大幅肢体动作。
避免：五官漂移、换脸、发型改变、服装改变、项链消失、手指畸形、嘴型与台词不同步、表情抽搐、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、AI网红脸、夸张哭戏、舞台朗诵感。

title: 女性一生连续长镜头老化过程
category: 电影级运镜与基础机位
crossCategories: 电影级运镜与基础机位
description: 这是一个复杂的电影级提示词，用于生成一段 15 秒的无缝长镜头视频，描绘一名女性从 5 岁到 85 岁的老化过程，并伴随环境与物体的形态变换。
positivePrompt:
创作一段 15 秒的超电影级连续长镜头。同一位女性从左向右走过，从幼童持续老化至老妪。在每个年龄段，她都清晰可辨。老化过程绝非跳跃式呈现：在整个镜头中，每一帧画面里她的四肢都在伸长，面部逐渐成熟，发色也在不断演变。

年龄链：5 岁、10 岁、16 岁、22 岁、30 岁、45 岁、65 岁、85 岁。

她最初是一个 5 岁的孩子，向前奔跑，怀里抱着一只毛绒兔子。随着她行走，双腿变长，步伐变大。兔子的柔软身体逐渐压缩，布料收紧并变方，耳朵折叠成肩带，最终变成她背上的书包。脚下的托儿所地板向前延伸成学校走廊，两侧墙壁向上升起。

书包盖掀起，包身变平，化作她抱在胸前的笔记本电脑。校服线头松动，逐渐变为休闲装，袖子自动卷至前臂。走廊墙壁上挂满海报，海报向下展开，随后向外推开变成黄昏时的城市街道，建筑从墙线处向上生长。

笔记本电脑盖合上，边缘变得圆润柔和，表面长出织物，变成她怀中包裹着熟睡婴儿的毯子。她的夹克变厚，领子折叠成柔软的开衫。街道外墙向内收缩，变成小公寓的墙壁，晨光从右侧射入。

毯子沿着她的前臂折叠，边角变硬成皮革，顶部升起一个提手，直到她变成拎着公文包的样子。开衫在肩部收紧，边缘变得锐利，化作一件剪裁合身的西装外套。公寓墙壁向两侧退去，天花板抬升，变成宽敞的办公空间。她的步伐变大，显得更加自信。

公文包的皮革变圆并分裂成编织线条，最终变成一个园艺篮。西装外套变回柔软的针织毛衣，织物纹理变得疏松。灰色从发根开始，一缕一缕地向发梢蔓延。办公空间边缘长出青草，变成夏末的林间小径。

她的步伐变小。篮子提手变窄、拉直并向下硬化，变成一根木制手杖，落地的节奏与她的步伐完全同步。林间小径变成温暖的客厅地板，墙壁在她周围向内生长。

最后一刻：她停在窗边。窗台上已经摆放着毛绒兔子、书包、笔记本电脑、折叠的毯子、皮包和编织篮，顺序与她携带它们时一致。她伸手触碰那只兔子，露出微笑。
originalPrompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-cinematic continuous one-shot. The same woman walks from left to right, aging continuously from a small child into an old woman. She is recognizably the same person at every age. The aging never happens in steps: her limbs lengthen, her face matures, and her hair changes color progressively across the entire shot, at every single frame.

Age chain: 5 years old, 10, 16, 22, 30, 45, 65, 85.

She starts as a five-year-old running forward, holding a stuffed rabbit against her chest. As she walks, her legs lengthen and her stride opens. The rabbit's soft body compacts and its fabric tightens and squares off, its ears folding down into shoulder straps until it sits on her back as a school satchel. The nursery floor under her feet stretches forward into a school corridor, walls sliding up on both sides.

The satchel's flap lifts and its body flattens into a laptop she carries against her chest. Her school uniform loosens thread by thread into casual clothes, sleeves rolling themselves up her forearms. The corridor walls fill with posters that unroll downward, then push outward into a city street at dusk, buildings growing upward from the wall line.

The laptop's lid closes and its edges round and soften, its surface growing fabric until it is a blanket wrapped around a sleeping infant in her arms. Her jacket thickens and its collar folds into a soft cardigan. The street facades slide inward and become the walls of a small apartment, morning light arriving from the right.

The blanket folds itself along her forearm and its corners harden into leather, a handle rising from the top until she is carrying a work bag. The cardigan tightens across her shoulders and its edges sharpen into a tailored blazer. The apartment walls retract sideways and the ceiling lifts, opening into a wide office floor. Her walk lengthens and gains confidence.

The bag's leather rounds and splits into woven strands until it is a garden basket. The blazer softens back into a knitted sweater, its weave loosening. Grey travels through her hair strand by strand from the roots outward. The office floor grows grass at the edges and becomes a garden path in late summer.

Her steps shorten. The basket handle narrows, straightens and hardens downward into a wooden cane that meets the ground exactly in rhythm with her step. The garden path becomes a warm living room floor, walls growing inward around her.

Final moment: she stops beside a window. On the sill, already there, sit the stuffed rabbit, the satchel, the laptop, the folded blanket, the leather bag and the woven basket, in the order she carried them. She touches the rabbit and smiles.

Wearing a faded terracotta T-shirt, lightweight beige cardigan, high-waisted dark-blue jeans, worn white sneakers, and carrying a simple canvas tote bag. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout.

Location: Ordinary Madrid residential neighborhood on a warm weekday evening. Small local grocery shop, apartment buildings with balconies, parked compact cars, scooters, plane trees, tiled sidewalks, recycling bins, and residents returning home from work. No famous landmarks, tourist streets, or staged activity.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine everyday behavior, natural body language, spontaneous local interactions, authentic Spanish neighborhood atmosphere.

Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting between shelves and her face, exposure pumping when entering and leaving the shop, faded colors, soft contrast, slight motion blur, DV compression artifacts, mild sensor noise, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
She walks down the residential sidewalk carrying an empty canvas tote. She checks a handwritten grocery list while approaching a small neighborhood shop.

00:03–00:06
Inside, she picks up tomatoes and oranges, comparing them casually before placing them into her basket. Autofocus briefly locks onto the colorful produce.

00:06–00:09

00:09–00:12
Outside, she rearranges the groceries inside her tote while standing beneath a tree. A scooter passes slowly behind her.

00:12–00:15
She notices the camcorder, laughs softly, lifts the grocery bag as if showing what she bought, and continues toward her apartment. The operator follows for a few steps before accidentally pointing at the pavement and cutting to black.

Audio: Natural ambience only–Spanish conversations, shop door bell, grocery bags rustling, footsteps, scooters, distant traffic, birds, apartment sounds, and light neighborhood chatter. No music. No narration.

Goal: A forgotten MiniDV home video from 2004, capturing an ordinary after-work grocery run in Madrid–local, casual, imperfect, warm, nostalgic, and completely believable.

title: 购物中心商业舞蹈 MV
description: 这是一个为 Seedance 2.5 设计的复杂多角色视频提示词，旨在创作一个 30 秒的购物中心商业广告。视频中三位风格迥异的舞者分别表演卡波耶拉（Capoeira）、偶像舞（Idol Dance）和霹雳舞（Breaking），共同完成一场协调的快闪表演。
positivePrompt:
将 I1 中的角色设定数据定义为 <A>。即使 I1 包含同一人物的多个视角、表情或服装细节，也请将其全部理解为同一角色的设计数据。<A> 的面部、发型、体型、服装结构、配色方案和身份仅参考 I1。

将 I2 中的角色设定数据定义为 <B>。（角色一致性规则同上）<B> 的特征仅参考 I2。

将 I3 中的角色设定数据定义为 <C>。（角色一致性规则同上）<C> 的特征仅参考 I3。

<A>、<B> 和 <C> 从始至终必须是三个不同的人。禁止换脸、禁止服装更换、禁止相互复制，背景人群不得成为这三位主角的复制品。整个 30 秒的过程均发生在大型现代购物中心的中央中庭；请勿切换至舞台、街道、摄影棚或其他建筑物。

[生成目标]
生成一个 30 秒的高密度购物中心品牌形象广告。前 27 秒呈现为高规格的舞蹈 MV 和公共快闪表演。在 27 秒时舞蹈正式结束，27-30 秒之间突然转变为正式、明亮且直白的商业广告结尾。核心不在于三个独立的独舞，而是三位主角完成一组具有明确角色分工且相互呼应的编舞，尽管他们很少同步动作。

A：流体 / 轨道：卡波耶拉。负责流动感、环绕、闪避、圆周运动和空间连接。
B：中心 / 钩子：以轻快的现代偶像舞为基础，加入 Waacking 手臂线条和极简的 Popping 强调。负责提供易于识别的记忆点（hook）、引导人群和中心指引。
C：力量 / 标点：霹雳舞。负责地板动作、旋转、力量动作（power moves）以及对音乐节奏的强调。

三人通过呼应、卡农式时序和分层编舞进行协作。观众必须能看出他们是在一起跳舞，但并非同步的偶像团体风格。

时间轴：
0-9 秒：确立角色差异。
9 秒：第一波快闪开始。
15 秒+：人群规模扩大。
18 秒+：自动扶梯和二楼人群加入。
24-27 秒：巅峰高潮。
27 秒+：所有舞蹈停止；进入购物中心商业广告结尾。

[空间与构图]
利用宽阔的横向空间和建筑深度；不要长时间将三人挤在画面中心。

初始布局：
A：左前区域。
B：中后区域。

originalPrompt: Sports vlog continuing the story of the same young Korean woman in her early 20s after completing traditional Chinese kung fu training. She wears the same training uniform and maintains perfect identity consistency throughout. The video takes place in the same authentic outdoor martial arts courtyard in China and is filmed mostly by a friend using a real handheld smartphone, with occasional selfie footage. Use natural hand shake, imperfect framing, autofocus shifts, exposure changes, motion blur, realistic courtyard ambience, student reactions, footsteps and breathing—never cinematic, professional, or action-movie style. She starts in selfie mode, excited but nervous, saying in Korean, “이제 배운 걸 한번 해볼게요!” before showing the training area. She respectfully begins a friendly supervised sparring match with another student, using safe, controlled footwork, blocks and training movements. As she gains confidence, she avoids a controlled attack and successfully scores points. After the final exchange, the instructor signals that she has won. Surprised and excited, she says, “제가 이겼어요? 진짜요?” She and her opponent respectfully smile and acknowledge each other while nearby students clap. Finally, she takes the phone back in selfie mode, slightly out of breath and proudly says, “처음엔 아무것도 몰랐는데 결국 이겼어요! 정말 재밌었어요!” She laughs, waves naturally and lowers the phone to end the vlog.

“We just kept calling it love.”

Quick handheld pan from the girl to the dog and back. She slowly steps backward and says: “Uh... don't come closer, okay...” The dog looks curious and harmless.

SHOT 3-0:04–0:06
The dog playfully runs a few steps toward her. She panics: “AAAAA RUN!” The camera operator reacts and moves backward.

She suddenly runs away, looking back over her shoulder. The iPhone camera follows while running, creating natural shaky footage. Her white fitted T-shirt, light-blue short denim shorts, and white low-profile slippers move naturally.

SHOT 5-0:08–0:10
Side close-up while she runs. She looks back and screams: “BRO, IT'S FOLLOWING ME!” The camera shakes as the friend behind the camera laughs.

SHOT 6-0:10–0:13
The camera widens as she runs toward her friend, waving her hands: “DON'T LAUGH! HELP ME, BRO!” The dog follows playfully without attacking, biting, or touching her.

SHOT 7- 0:13–0:15
She reaches a safe spot, bends over briefly to catch her breath, then looks at the camera with an annoyed and embarrassed expression: “I was literally just passing by, why did that turn into cardio?!” The friend bursts out laughing. Abrupt cut.

Amateur one-handed iPhone recording. Natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, slight tilt, occasional autofocus shifts, automatic exposure changes, realistic motion blur, natural smartphone colors, subtle digital sharpening and compression. Environmental details remain visible. No cinematic look.

description: 一个电影感犯罪悬疑场景提示词，包含固定低角度镜头、饮料泼溅引发的紧张互动，以及一个突如其来的幽默反转。

description: 一份高度详细的提示词，用于创作 10 秒钟吉卜力/《夏日大作战》风格的动画片段，展现角色视角从现实过渡到多彩虚拟世界的过程。

Mio 前半段佩戴眼镜，后半段切换为虚拟形态（发梢呈现樱花色光芒，不戴眼镜）；Yoru 处于发光形态。

登场角色的绘制需与所附参考资料的外观和配色完全一致。

一段 10 秒钟的吉卜力/《夏日大作战》风格手绘 2D 赛璐珞动画电影片段。

柔和的轮廓线、淡雅的水彩背景、赛璐珞风格的双层阴影，以及丰富的体积光效果。

画面衔接上一场景中眼镜边框亮起的动作。

[最重要]

0 秒时眼镜发出微弱的蓝光，2 秒内蓝灰色的现实世界溶解成无数发光的玻璃碎片，开始坠入色彩斑斓的虚拟世界。

0.0–1.0 秒：少女眼睛的超特写。

一圈光环穿过智能眼镜镜片，丰富的色彩倒映在她的眼中。

将其描绘为“转化”而非“破坏”。Mio 的身体被轻柔地托起，悬浮在空中。

2.0–4.0 秒：Mio 在纯白色的无限空间中坠落。五彩斑斓的光之河流在她身边盘旋。前方出现一条光之尾引领方向。虚拟世界的 Yoru 轮廓被琥珀色的光粒子包围，尾部拖曳着流星般的光带，铃铛发出琥珀色的光芒。

6.0–8.0 秒：与 Yoru 并肩穿过光之河。色彩斑斓的光带在两侧高速掠过，Mio 的头发和裙摆在风中飘动。

小女孩在悬浮于无尽云海之上的巨大发光彩虹之路上高速滑行。巨大的漂浮岛屿环绕在天空中，瀑布倾泻而下，汇入远方的云层。

description: 一个精致的电影感提示词，用于创作一段 30 秒无缝衔接的时间旅行序列，通过单一、不间断的镜头展现房屋穿越不同历史时期的过程。
positivePrompt:
创作一段 30 秒超写实电影感时间之旅，要求采用一个完全无缝、连续、不间断的镜头。严禁使用剪辑、淡入淡出、叠化、蒙太奇、瞬间移动或重置。

一位女性走进一栋普通的老房子，并在其中持续移动，同时房间随世纪更迭而发生演变。
从黄昏开始。
一栋朴素的老房子孤零零地矗立在安静的田野上。
这位女性从前门进入。
镜头紧随其后进入一个简单的厨房。
当她穿过一道门时，房间无缝转变为维多利亚时代的室内风格：深色木材、黄铜、煤气灯和复古家具。
她继续穿过走廊。
当她拾级而上时，墙壁和楼梯在她周围发生变换。
维多利亚时代的房子变成了中世纪的石厅，挂着挂毯，点着蜡烛，摆放着粗糙的木制家具。
她打开另一扇门。
镜头紧随其后。
室内变成了古老的石砌住所，透过窗户可以看到一座古城。
她继续前行。
当她穿过相连的房间时，建筑在她周围迅速演变：古石变为中世纪木结构，木结构变为工业时代的砖铁结构，工业时代变为 20 世纪现代风格，随后是当代的玻璃与混凝土结构。
这位女性随每个时代自然变化：服装、发型、配饰和姿态都在适应，但她始终是同一个人。
她到达最后一扇门。
她打开门。
镜头跟随她进入未来。
房子变成了一座非凡的未来主义住宅，融入了一座广阔的绿色城市。玻璃墙展示着垂直花园、高架交通和发光的建筑。
她走进最后一个房间。
房间空无一物，只有一把简单的木椅。
镜头缓慢地穿过门口向后移动。
随着镜头后退，未来主义风格的房间留在她身后，而早期的房屋版本通过连续的门口显现出来：现代、工业、中世纪、古代。
镜头到达最初的入口。
我们第一次从外部看到整个房子。
它不再是旧的。
它变得巨大且古老，被完全改变的未来景观所环绕。
透过远处的窗户，依然可以看到那位女性。
房子历经了每一个时代。
结尾传达出一种宁静的感悟：尽管文明彻底改变，但这个地方铭记了所有的一切。
照片级电影写实感，情感丰富，神秘，优雅，令人惊叹，适合全家观看。变换必须在镜头移动过程中物理发生，绝不能作为突兀的场景切换。保持女性持续移动，直到最后一刻。
originalPrompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic time-journey as ONE completely seamless, continuous, unbroken camera shot. No cuts, fades, dissolves, montage, teleportation, or resets.

A woman enters an ordinary old house and moves continuously through it while the same rooms transform through centuries.
Begin at dusk.
A modest old house stands alone in a quiet field.
The woman enters through the front door.
The camera follows directly behind her into a simple kitchen.
As she passes through a doorway, the room transforms seamlessly into a Victorian interior: dark wood, brass, gaslight and period furniture.
She continues through the hallway.
The walls and staircase transform around her as she climbs.
The Victorian house becomes a medieval stone hall with tapestries, candles and rough wooden furniture.
She opens another door.
The camera follows.
The interior becomes an ancient stone dwelling surrounded by an ancient city visible through the windows.
She keeps moving.
The architecture rapidly evolves around her as she passes through connected rooms: ancient stone becomes medieval timber, timber becomes industrial brick and iron, industrial becomes twentieth-century modern, then contemporary glass and concrete.
The woman changes naturally with each era: clothing, hairstyle, accessories and posture adapting while she remains the same continuous person.
She reaches the final door.
She opens it.
The camera follows her into the future.
The house has become an extraordinary futuristic residence integrated into a vast green city. Glass walls reveal vertical gardens, elevated transit and luminous architecture.
She walks into one final room.
It is completely empty except for a simple wooden chair.
The camera slowly moves backward through the doorway.
As it retreats, the futuristic room remains behind her while earlier versions of the house appear through successive doorways: modern, industrial, medieval, ancient.
The camera reaches the original entrance.
For the first time, we see the entire house from outside.
It is no longer old.
It is enormous and ancient-looking, surrounded by a completely transformed future landscape.
The woman is still visible through the distant window.
The house has remained through every age.
End on the quiet realization that while civilizations changed completely, this one place remembered them all.
Photorealistic cinematic realism, emotional, mysterious, elegant, awe-inspiring, family-friendly. The transformations must occur physically during camera movement, never as abrupt scene changes. Keep the woman continuously moving until the final moment.

在享受了吊篮里的宁静时光后，热气球平稳地降落在开阔的田野上。她在着陆时发出了自然的笑声，走出吊篮后拍摄了最后一段自拍，说道：“今天玩得太开心了！下次见，拜拜！”她挥了挥手，用手遮住镜头结束了 Vlog。全程保持自然的眨眼、呼吸、即兴反应、真实的热气球晃动、乘客活动以及风声和喷火声。

title: 奢华香水商业广告
description: 一份高端、大师级的电影感商业广告提示词，专为原创奢华香水品牌设计，侧重于材质、光影及感官细节的呈现。
positivePrompt:

画面比例 16:9，时长 10 秒，电影级写实风格，超高端商业摄影。主色调：深黑、黑曜石色、暗金、琥珀金、淡酒红及象牙白高光。整体场景处于暗调中，光影极其精准，利用少量高光勾勒香水瓶身。材质参考：顶级香水广告、珠宝广告、红毯高定大片、博物馆级静物摄影：大面积黑色留白，低调奢华，丝绒般的阴影，金质液体如同封存在黑曜石中的火焰。整体氛围不得嘈杂、浮夸、霓虹赛博、过度偏紫蓝或呈现塑料感。

场景设定：香水瓶放置在黑色丝绒与黑曜石镜面石材交界处的展示台上。背景为极暗的巴黎夜色室内，如同私人沙龙、古老宫殿的烛光房间或高定香氛实验室。远处有模糊的烛光、暗金画框、黑色帷幕、轻烟及隐约的花瓣剪影，但背景必须虚化，以免喧宾夺主。极细微的金色香氛颗粒在空气中漂浮，以极其克制、写实且优雅的方式将香气视觉化。不出现清晰的人脸；可有黑色丝绸或高定裙摆的模糊掠影以营造氛围，但产品始终是绝对主角。
镜头设计：
0-2s：从全黑开始。一道极窄的暖金色光束从左上方缓慢射入，首先照亮黑色丝绒表面的柔和褶皱。微距特写，极浅景深，展现丝绒绒毛与细小香氛颗粒。随后，一道锐利的高光勾勒出瓶底黑曜石玻璃的边缘。观众此时尚无法看清全貌，仅能感受到昂贵、神秘且极具仪式感的开场。

4-6s：切换至香水液体的极度特写。内部金质液体轻微流动，如蜂蜜、琥珀与熔金的混合体，浓稠而优雅。光线在边缘产生复杂的折射，伴随细小的金色涟漪。瓶颈附近升起淡淡烟雾，烟雾中隐约可见黑玫瑰花瓣、香草荚与琥珀树脂的抽象剪影，但这些不应看起来像道具，仅作为嗅觉意象。此段需极具感官冲击力，观众应几乎能“闻到”香气。

摄影要求：电影级商业摄影语言，ARRI Alexa 35 或同等质感，结合 85mm 和 100mm 微距镜头，浅景深，真实的镜头呼吸感，精准的光控，黑旗遮光，窄金色主光，柔和烛光反射，丝绒阴影。焦点锐度集中在瓶身边缘、金属瓶盖、液体折射、品牌标识及黑曜石玻璃质感上。背景必须柔和虚化。
灯光要求：低调照明，在黑色空间中用极简光线塑造瓶身。主光为暖金色窄光束，补光极弱，轮廓光略带冷白以增加黑曜石边缘的立体感。烛光仅用于背景氛围。高光必须细腻、平滑且昂贵，不可过曝或产生廉价闪烁，无彩虹伪影。阴影丰富但保留瓶身轮廓。
材质要求：黑曜石玻璃需厚重、写实，具备半透明折射与镜面反射；金属瓶盖需为暗金拉丝质感，非明亮黄色塑料；香水液体需呈现高浓度琥珀金的深度与流动感；丝绒需柔软且具暗部层次；石材平台需为带克制反射的黑色镜面。所有材质需呈现真实的高端摄影感，而非 3D 资产库或廉价渲染。
动态要求：运镜极其缓慢、平稳且克制。允许的动态：缓慢的光线扫过、轻微的推拉与环绕、轻微的液体流动、缓慢升起的烟雾、少量缓慢落下的花瓣、轻微漂浮的颗粒。无快速剪辑，无过度旋转，无液体飞溅，无夸张爆炸，无魔法特效，无悬浮产品，无镜头抖动。
后期质感：电影级调色，高对比度暗调，纯净的黑色，丰富的金色但不饱和，几乎不含皮肤元素。如同高定香水广告。添加极轻微的胶片颗粒、柔和的高光溢出、真实的镜头暗角，但不可显得脏乱或过度模糊。最终成品需适合作为奢华香水发布会的视觉素材，具备艺术高级感。
声音构想（视觉参考）：深沉的弦乐，微弱的玻璃共鸣，轻柔的呼吸声，噼啪的火光，最后一声轻微的金属音。尽管是生成视频，视觉节奏应配合高端配乐：0-4s 神秘铺垫，4-6s 感官爆发，6-8s 产品揭示，8-10s 品牌定格。
负面要求：无真实品牌 Logo（Chanel, Dior, Guerlain, Tom Ford, YSL 等）；无乱码、拼写错误、长字幕、促销标语、价格、购买按钮、电商背景、直播灯光、廉价玻璃、塑料瓶盖、过度明亮的金色、杂乱桌面、普通浴室或商场柜台；无干扰人物、手部畸形、瓶身变形、液体穿模、浓烟、过多花瓣、低分辨率、过曝、抖动或 AI 畸变。整体氛围必须是黑曜石般的神秘、鎏金般的奢华、高定般的克制，具备百万预算的制作水准。16:9，10秒

个镜头开始，他一直站在那里，不再移动。- <El Patrón> 从第一帧到最后一帧，一直坐在吧台的凳子上，位于 Vova 停靠点以东约 2.5 米处。他从不站起，也从不离开凳子。- <Anya> 从第一帧到最后一帧，独自坐在点唱机旁边的东侧桌子前，面前放着威士忌和平板电脑。她从不换桌。- 六名男子坐在中心和南侧的散桌旁，均为坐姿，无人坐在吧台。吧台轴线：Vova 和 El Patrón 34°C，尘土飞扬；东墙点唱机播放着低沉的墨西哥流浪乐队吉他曲，伴有风扇电机声、玻璃碰木头的声音、靴子踩在地砖上的声音；门在闭合时发出两次撞击声；房间底噪在每个安静的节拍下始终存在，绝非数字静音；环境音在每句台词间隙回升。- 角色：<Vova> 面部参考 @[Video 1](video_1)，头发及其他部分参考 @[Image 2](image_2)。身高 190 cm，深棕色波浪卷发垂至肩部，中分，浓密且略显凌乱，遮住耳廓顶部——头发取自 @[Image 2](image_2)，绝不根据视频参考重绘。黑色短款夹克，前襟两侧饰有银色圆盘装饰，黑色衬衫领口敞开，佩戴银链，黑色牛仔裤外侧缝线处有银色纽扣，穿着磨损的黑色靴子。他比 El Patrón 高约 7 cm。在所有镜头中保持一致。<El Patrón> 对应 @[Image 4](image_4)。身高 Vova：场景指导：保持自然，让环境去叙事，不要刻意表演。动力：他清楚手提箱里装的是什么，并暗自享受对方并不知情的事实。目标：让他们主动询问，而不是让他们听他解释。障碍：想要解释自己的冲动；只需一句推销，他就会被这个房间所掌控。策略：在被问到两次之前保持沉默，回答时延迟半拍，且比预期少说一个词，每次回答后查看镜子，观察对方是否还在等待更多信息，并每次都给予更少的回应。动作：行走，然后将手提箱平放在吧台上，不慌不忙地操作锁扣，目光始终专注于任务，自然的眨眼节奏。- 表演 — El Patrón：场景指导：同样，保持自然，这里没有任何事值得他站起来。动力：今年有三个人带着手提箱走进这扇门，而他依然是那个坐着的人。目标：让他从进来的门离开，而无需自己起身。障碍：好奇心，他拒绝表现出来，但这种好奇心却从他每一次重复的问题中流露出来。策略：提问，然后让停顿的时间超过舒适的限度，观察对方是否会填补空白；对方从未填补，所以他不得不再次询问，每一次重复都让他处于劣势。动作：在吧台上缓慢转动酒杯，从不拿起。目光始终专注于任务，自然的眨眼节奏。- 表演 — Anya：监听任务：她正在确认平板电脑上的数字是最终结果还是仍在变动，在结果确定前，吧台的事与她无关。对比轴线：风险。Vova 追求风险，El Patrón 抵御风险。两人言语稀少，语气平淡、干涩——喜剧效果在于他们听起来如此相似，却有着截然相反的诉求。两人都不是反派：两个安静的男人在吧台交换简短的句子，而年长者因为不得不问两次而处于劣势。视线几何，锚定于房间和每个人的身体，而非屏幕边缘：(A) Vova 和 El Patrón 在吧台面朝北——每个人都看着对方在斑驳镜子中的倒影，真实的头部始终转向酒瓶方向；(B) Anya 的桌子位于 El Patrón 右肩后方——为了看向她，他将头转向右肩并回望；(C) 门位于两人正后方的南侧——瞥视

Controls the room itself only — architecture, layout, materials, window positions, bar position, fixtures, colour of the space. Every shot is staged inside this room. @[Video 1](video_1) = video reference of Vova's face. Controls facial geometry, features, skin and expression range INSIDE the hairline only: forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, complexion. It does not control hair, hairline, head shape above the hairline, or anything below the neck. @[Image 2](image_2) = character sheet. Controls Vova's hair length, parting, volume and fall, plus his build, height, wardrobe and silhouette. @[Image 3](image_3) = prop turnaround. Controls the guitar's shape, colour, wear and the logo on the lower bout only. @[Image 4](image_4) = character sheet. Controls El Patrón's face, hair, build and wardrobe. @[Image 5](image_5) = photo reference. Controls Anya's face, hair, glasses, earrings and jacket. @[Image 6](image_6) = brand reference. Controls the logo shape, its orange-to-violet gradient, the wordmark, the subscribe button and the server-room environment, for the final shot only. ACTIVE REFERENCES: @[Image 1](image_1) 95% · @[Video 1](video_1) 90% (face only) · @[Image 2](image_2) 95% (hair, build, wardrobe) · @[Image 3](image_3) 95% · @[Image 4](image_4) 90% · @[Image 5](image_5) 90% · @[Image 6](image_6) 100% (final shot only) LOCATION MAP — fixed for the entire piece, every shot is staged against these anchors: - The room runs roughly 12 metres east to west and 9 metres north to south. Terracotta tile floor, adobe plaster walls, exposed dark timber ceiling. - NORTH WALL: the bar, 6.2 metres long, brass rail, a spotted mirror and a full wall of bottles behind it. A single 2400K bulb hangs over the bar. - SOUTH WALL: the batwing doors, 1.4 metres wide, the only entrance. - WEST WALL: three shuttered windows. This is the only daylight source in the room. - EAST WALL: a jukebox, and one table beside it. - CENTRE: a slow ceiling fan, and scattered tables between the doors and the bar. FIXED POSITIONS — each character occupies exactly one position for the whole piece and never appears in two places: - <Bartender> behind the bar, centre, facing south into the room. - <Vova> enters through the south doors, walks north-west across the floor, and stops at the WEST END of the bar. He stands there from shot 3 onward and does not move again. - <El Patrón> is seated on a stool at the bar, about 2.5 metres EAST of where Vova stops, from the first frame to the last. He never stands and never leaves the stool. - <Anya> is seated alone at the EAST TABLE beside the jukebox, whisky and tablet in front of her, from the first frame to the last. She never moves to another table. - Six men at the scattered centre and south tables, seated, none of them at the bar. BAR AXIS: Vova and El Patrón stand and sit side by side along the bar, both facing north toward the bottles. They speak to each other through the spotted mirror, not face to face. The camera stays SOUTH of the bar for the entire piece and never goes behind it. GLOBAL STYLE NOTES: - look: late afternoon sun through the three west shutters as the single daylight source, hard-edged at 3000K, throwing long slatted bars across the tile and up the north wall, dust and cigarette smoke standing visible in the shafts; the 2400K bulb over the bar adds a small warm pool exactly where Vova stops, while El Patrón's stool sits in the gap between two shutter bars and reads darker without any separate lighting; the room falls to deep amber shadow away from the windows; 35mm film still, Kodak Vision3 500T pushed one stop, heavy grain, halation on the shutter slats, warm ochre grade with the shadows lifted to brown - setting: dry air at 34°C, thick with dust; a mariachi guitar playing low from the jukebox on the east wall, the fan motor, glass on wood, boots on tile, the doors knocking twice as they settle; room tone stays present under every quiet beat, never digital silence; ambience ducks under every spoken line and returns in the gap - characters: <Vova> face from @[Video 1](video_1), hair and everything else from @[Image 2](image_2). 190 cm, dark brown wavy hair falling to the shoulders, centre-parted, thick and slightly unruly, covering the tops of the ears — the hair is taken from @[Image 2](image_2) and is never redrawn from the video reference. Black cropped jacket with silver conchos down both fronts, black shirt open at the throat, silver chain, black jeans with silver buttons down the outer seam, worn black boots. He stands about 7 cm taller than El Patrón. Keep identical in every shot. <El Patrón> corresponds to @[Image 4](image_4). 183 cm, moustache, hair slicked back, white linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, gold chain, dark trousers, brown belt, brown boots, gold watch, rings. Keep identical in every shot. <Anya> corresponds to @[Image 5](image_5). Short blonde-grey hair, round glasses, silver hoop earrings, black blazer with white stitching. Keep identical in every shot. <Bartender> a thin older man, apron, towel over the shoulder. Keep identical in every shot. - acting — Vova: scene direction: keep it ordinary, let the room do the work, never sell anything fuel: he knows exactly what is in the case and quietly enjoys that they do not goal: make them ask instead of making them listen obstacle: the pull to explain himself; one sentence of pitch and the room owns him tactic: says nothing until asked twice, then answers a half-beat late and one word shorter than expected, checking the mirror after each answer to see whether the man is waiting for more, and giving him less each time channel: walking, then setting the case flat on the bar and working the latches without hurry gaze always engaged in the task, natural blink cadence - acting — El Patrón: scene direction: same, keep it ordinary, nothing here is worth standing up for fuel: three men came through those doors this year with a case and he is still the one sitting goal: get him out through the same doors without leaving the stool obstacle: curiosity, which he refuses to show and which leaks through every repeated question tactic: asks, then lets the pause run past comfortable to see whether the man fills it; the man never does, so he has to ask again, and each repeat costs him a little ground channel: turning a glass slowly on the bar top, never lifting it gaze always engaged in the task, natural blink cadence - acting — Anya: listener_task: she is checking whether the number on her tablet is final or still moving, and the bar is not part of that until it is CONTRAST AXIS: risk. Vova courts it, El Patrón holds ground against it. Both speak sparsely, both flat, both dry — the comedy lives in how alike they sound while wanting opposite things. Neither is a villain: two quiet men at a bar trading short sentences, and the older one loses ground only by having to ask twice. EYELINE GEOMETRY, anchored to the room and to each body, never to screen sides: (A) Vova and El Patrón face north at the bar — each looks at the other's REFLECTION in the spotted mirror, and their real heads stay turned toward the bottles; (B) Anya's table sits past El Patrón's OWN RIGHT shoulder — to reach her he rotates his head toward that shoulder and looks back over it; (C) the doors sit directly behind both of them to the south — glancing

category: 叙事、动作与电影化镜头

description: 一个为 Seedance 2.5 设计的电影级动作序列提示词，展示了一位年迈的肥胖大师在道场庭院中，以流畅的编排和变速特效优雅地击败多名对手。
positivePrompt:
超写实武术动作，兼具荒诞的优雅与高级的慢动作编排。使用 ARRI Alexa 35 搭配变形镜头拍摄，结合戏剧性的特写、低角度追踪、平滑的环绕镜头、快速摇摄以及从激烈变速到悬浮慢动作的切换。明亮的日光，空气中漂浮着细微尘埃，电影级景深，丰富的织物动态，在写实的基础上带有一丝超现实的英雄色彩。
核心人物：年迈的肥胖武术大师，圆润身材，体格魁梧，秃顶，两侧留有灰发，表情生动，眼神平静，身穿宽松的传统练功服，脚蹬软底布鞋，动作出人意料地优雅。对手：三名身穿现代街头服饰的成年男性，身高体型各异，表现得过度自信且具有攻击性。
场景：古老石墙与朴素道场入口之间的开阔训练庭院，地面整洁，几片落叶飘过，没有人群，没有干扰。

照片级动作，超高精度的动作编排，高级慢动作，清晰的战斗空间感，特征鲜明的对手，稳定的解剖结构，体型与敏捷度之间形成时尚的荒诞对比，真实的受击反应，无血腥，比例正常，无拉伸变形。

0-5 秒：低角度中远景追踪镜头 - 年迈的肥胖大师双手背在身后，在画面中心从容站立，呼吸平稳。三名男子在他周围散开并开始逼近。特写镜头展示他柔软的腹部和随风飘动的宽松袖口，随后特写他平静的双眼。
5-9 秒：缓慢推镜头 - 第一名攻击者猛冲过来。时间拉长。大师仅移动了几英寸重心，以荒诞的轻松感险之又险地避开了攻击，他的动作与其体型相比显得不可思议地流畅。
9-15 秒：带有变速特效的优雅环绕镜头 - 在一个无缝的动作流中，他通过轻柔的掌法转向重定向了第一名男子，转身用身体撞击第二名男子，俯身躲过第三名男子的攻击，随后展开一系列流畅的反击：袖口拨挡、胯部转动、扫腿、旋转肘击重定向，以及一个令人惊叹的优雅半转身，同时让两名攻击者失去平衡。
15-20 秒：英雄特写转广角展示 - 极度慢动作：当他完成最后一组荒诞优雅的终结技时，他的脸颊和长袍随之起伏，三名男子全部倒在他周围。他平静地呼出一口气，整理了一下长袍，拍了拍肚子，恢复了平静的站姿。
originalPrompt:
Ultra-realistic martial-arts action with absurd elegance and premium slow-motion choreography. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses, combining dramatic close-ups, low-angle tracking, smooth orbit moves, whip pans and intense speed ramps into suspended slow motion. Bright daylight, subtle dust in the air, cinematic depth, rich fabric motion, grounded realism with a slightly surreal heroic tone.
Central figure: elderly obese martial-arts master, round body, heavy build, bald crown with grey side hair, expressive face, calm eyes, loose traditional training clothes, soft slippers, unexpectedly graceful movement. Opponents: three adult men in modern street clothing, all clearly different in height and build, overconfident and aggressive.
Open training courtyard between old stone walls and a modest dojo entrance, clean ground, a few leaves blowing, no crowd, no distractions.

Photorealistic action, hyper-choreographed movement, premium slow motion, readable combat geography, clearly differentiated opponents, stable anatomy, stylish absurd contrast between body type and agility, realistic impact reactions, no gore, normal proportions without stretch.

0-5s: Low-angle medium-wide tracking shot - The elderly obese master stands relaxed at center frame, hands behind his back, breathing calmly. The three men spread around him and begin closing in. Close-up on his soft belly and loose sleeves moving in the breeze, then close-up on his serene eyes.
5-9s: Slow push-in - The first attacker lunges. Time stretches. The old master shifts his weight by inches, narrowly avoiding the strike with absurd ease, his movement impossibly smooth for his size.
9-15s: Elegant orbit with speed ramps - In one seamless flow, he redirects the first man with a soft palm turn, pivots into the second with a spinning body check, ducks under the third, then unleashes a series of fluid counters: sleeve deflection, hip turn, sweeping step, rotating elbow redirection, and one surprisingly graceful half-spin that sends two attackers off balance at once.
15-20s: Hero close-up into wide reveal - Extreme slow motion: his cheeks and robe ripple as he performs one final absurdly elegant finishing combination, leaving all three men downed around him. He calmly exhales, adjusts his robe, pats his stomach once, and resumes a peaceful stance.

title: 意大利女性纪录片表演场景
description: 这是一个高度详细的电影感提示词，用于拍摄意大利女性的纪录片风格特写。它规定了微妙的情感节奏、精确的对话时机以及营造真实表演氛围的音效设计。
positivePrompt: 克制的纪录片镜头，单次连续拍摄，无剪辑。真实、自然的稳定镜头，亲密的特写构图。细腻而低调，一位 28 岁的意大利女性，深色头发松散地垂在脸颊两侧，身着干练的蓝色西装，领口敞开，正中特写，与确认的开场画面完全一致：一侧柔和的窗光，低饱和度的中性色调，浅景深。她以近乎耳语的声音说话，带有明显的意大利口音英语，语调平淡、克制、不紧不慢，每一个字都经过深思熟虑，极其简洁地吐出，不露声色。她保持着开场画面的构图，镇定自若，在难以捉摸的平静下流露出一丝克制。柔和的室内环境音，安静的呼吸声，远处环境的嗡嗡声。无音乐或配乐，仅有现场原声。摄像机在前四秒（0-4 秒）保持开场画面的精确构图，在完全静止中进行几乎不可察觉的推镜头。她保持不动，仅有一次自然的眨眼（4-6.5 秒），然后开口，声音微弱、平淡且均匀，元音中带有淡淡的口音：“Who told you my name is Jill?”（6.5-8 秒），长久的停顿，屏住呼吸，随后说出“Tell me. Please.”（8-9.5 秒），话语消散在近乎寂静中。最后节奏：她保持静止，眼神坚定，双唇紧闭，表情难以捉摸，静止状态未被打破（9.5-10 秒）。面部特征始终保持稳定，仅有一次自然眨眼，表演保持在最微小的可见努力范围内。

description: 一个详细的电影级提示词，用于创作一段 30 秒的视频序列，展现阳光明媚的意大利老街上的时间静止特效。

日常生活场景。行人穿行，自行车经过，鸽子在头顶飞过，树叶在微风中摇曳。她平静地穿过人群，看起来完全掌控一切。

5–8 秒：
她突然停下脚步，抬起手打了个响指。

一股强大而优雅的无形冲击波从她的指尖向外扩散。空气发生扭曲，灰尘和树叶向外荡漾，随后一切瞬间静止。

8–15 秒：
绝对的静止。行人定格在迈步的瞬间，鸽子悬停在空中，自行车停止在运动中，树叶挂在半空，咖啡溅出的水花凝固在杯子上方。

只有她可以移动。

当她穿过这条不可思议的静止街道时，摄像机缓慢地环绕着她。她观察着一颗悬浮的雨滴状水珠，轻轻触碰它，然后继续向前走。

15–20 秒：
她注意到一只鸽子悬停在离地面几英寸的地方。她从鸽子下方走过，抬头露出一抹玩味的微笑，然后随意地走过一个拿着咖啡杯的静止男子。她微妙地将杯子移动了几厘米，然后走开。

20–24 秒：
她到达街道中央并转向镜头。她身后的一切依然保持着完美的静止状态。

她露出一抹自信的浅笑，再次抬手打了个响指。

24–28 秒：
第二次冲击波向外爆发，比第一次更强烈、更具戏剧性。光线穿过空气发生折射，静止的世界突然恢复了生机。

鸽子拍打翅膀飞走，树叶落下，行人继续迈步，咖啡自然溅落，自行车继续行驶，城市氛围瞬间回归。

28–30 秒：
她保持着完全的冷静，而周围的人仿佛什么都没发生过一样继续着他们的动作。她转身向老街深处走去。

Normal life. Pedestrians cross, bicycles pass, pigeons fly overhead, leaves move in the breeze. She walks calmly through the crowd, looking completely in control.

Absolute stillness. Pedestrians are frozen mid-step, pigeons suspended in flight, a bicycle stopped mid-motion, leaves hanging in the air, a coffee splash frozen above a cup.

Only she can move.

20–24s:

She gives a confident half-smile, raises her hand and snaps again.

24–28s:
A second shockwave explodes outward, stronger and more dramatic. Light bends through the air as the frozen world suddenly comes alive again.

Pigeons flap away, leaves fall, pedestrians continue their steps, coffee splashes naturally, bicycles move and city ambience instantly returns.

28–30s:
She remains completely calm while everyone around her continues as if nothing happened. She turns and walks deeper into the old-town street.

The camera rises into a beautiful overhead wide shot and reveals the entire bustling city street.

Premium cinematic filmmaking, photorealistic, natural sunlight, 50mm cinema lens, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and hair, physically accurate motion and physics, subtle film grain, HDR, sophisticated color grading, smooth Steadicam choreography, dramatic but realistic VFX, natural shadows and reflections.

10–12 sec:
At the exact same moment, the cat looks down at itself, now standing on two human legs. It stares at the girl and casually says, “Finally. Your turn.”

13–15 sec:
The cat confidently walks toward the kitchen while the girl, now in the cat's body, desperately follows.

19–21 sec:

22–24 sec:
The girl freezes in embarrassment and chases the cat around the living room. The cat laughs and runs away with the phone.

25–27 sec:
They suddenly hear the front door unlocking. Both freeze. Her parents/owner are coming home.

28–30 sec:
They quickly run back to the sofa and switch places again. She returns to normal and sits innocently beside the cat. The cat looks at her and whispers, “Your secret is safe… for now.” She stares at it in horror.

title: 黑曜石元宇宙动作游戏场景

positivePrompt:
1. 设定调色板规则："一切皆为黑曜石，深紫色火山玻璃，唯一的光源是橙色熔岩，黑暗且带有霓虹感"。必须严格锁定，否则模型会跑偏变成明亮的奇幻风格。

2. 固定摄像机："第三人称，摄像机始终锁定在英雄身后"。这是赋予其游戏感而非随机电影镜头感的关键。

3. 一位英雄，一种强调色："一位身穿黑曜石套装的女战士，带有发光的橙色霓虹灯和橙色手枪，每一帧角色保持一致"。

4. 像编写游戏流程一样加入时间戳，直接从动作中开始："00:00 已经在奔跑和射击，00:03 一只熔岩怪物从地下冲出，00:07 她开火，00:12 一只更大的怪物冲过来，00:15 它爆炸，英雄获胜"。从动作开始，绝不要静止不动。

5. 在结尾禁用默认元素："无日光，无蓝天，无游戏 UI，无血条，无文字"。这一行指令能有效消除平庸感。
originalPrompt:

4. write it like gameplay with timestamps, open mid-action: "00:00 already sprinting and firing, 00:03 a lava monster bursts out of the ground, 00:07 she opens fire, 00:12 a bigger one charges, 00:15 it explodes, hero beat". start on movement, never standing still

description: 一个为 Seedance 2.5 设计的详尽电影感动作提示词，呈现了伊斯坦布尔雨夜街头格斗的写实手持拍摄序列。
positivePrompt:

[素材绑定]
image1 = 第一位角色 / 主角参考。
image2 = 第二位角色 / 攻击者参考。

使用 image1 作为面部特征、比例、发型、肤色、皮肤纹理、身体比例、年龄、服装逻辑、鞋子、配饰及整体气质的参考。
使用 image2 作为攻击者的面部特征、比例、发型、肤色、皮肤纹理、身体比例、年龄、服装逻辑、鞋子、配饰及整体气质的参考。

两者均为明显的成年女性格斗者。
保持角色辨识度，但允许自然的现场表情、湿发摆动、呼吸起伏、肌肉紧绷、疼痛反应以及真实的动作形变。
不要将面部固定为僵硬的照片。不要制作角色概念图、拼贴画、分镜脚本、标签、文字、边框或面板。

[真实纹理要求]
必须避免 AI 美颜感。
保留真实的皮肤纹理、轻微的不对称感、真实的毛孔、眼下细纹、湿润的碎发、雨水打湿后的皮肤反光、自然的眨眼、下颌紧绷、不均匀的呼吸、肌肉发力以及真实的疼痛反应。
面部不能看起来像塑料玩偶、数字替身、过度磨皮，也不能有玻璃质感的眼睛或过于完美的五官。

[场景]
雨后的伊斯坦布尔夜间街道。整场格斗仅发生在这条街道上。
街道狭窄且真实，地面湿滑光亮，有水坑、碎石、散落的垃圾、停放的车辆、老旧建筑墙面、路边护栏、昏暗的路灯、远处的霓虹光晕、潮湿的雾气和雨水倒影。
氛围硬核、危险、寒冷的雨夜，具有新黑色电影的质感。

一辆深色轿车从一开始就固定停在街道右侧或后方。它必须在整个镜头中保持相同的空间位置，最终成为主角被踢飞后撞击的目标。不要让车辆突然出现。

[核心动作原则]
真实的近身格斗，非舞蹈，非武术表演，非超能力。
每一次攻击都必须有清晰的因果链：
蓄力 -> 攻击路径 -> 接触或擦过 -> 身体反应 -> 重心改变。
禁止假打、隔空反应、身体穿模、无缘无故跌倒或无重力飞行。

动作必须快速、凶猛且清晰，但不能混乱。
两人都必须看起来像受过训练的真实格斗演员。攻击者更加主动和凶猛；主角起初冷静、轻蔑且精准，但最终被重击击中并击退，处于劣势。

[摄影]
连续的手持长镜头，无剪辑，无黑屏转场，无瞬间移动。
摄像机路径必须清晰：
主角肩后 OTS 开场 -> 自然移动至侧面特写 -> 近身格斗环绕追踪 -> 跟随主角被踢飞的方向 -> 推入主角撞在受损车辆上的面部特写。
手持摄影应贴近、流畅且具有沉浸感，但不能晃动到无法看清动作。
仅在关键的近距离接触和最终重击时刻使用短暂的变速；不要在整个片段中使用慢动作。

[时间轴]

0.0–2.5s

主角并不慌乱，只是微微转头，眼神冷静。

2.5–5.5s

攻击者冲至近距离，向主角面部挥出快速刺拳或右勾拳。
仅在拳头擦过脸侧的瞬间使用极短的变速。
主角没有大幅度闪避，没有后仰，没有后退。她只是在最后一刻做了最小幅度的头部后撤和下颌转动。
拳头必须清晰地从她脸颊前几厘米处擦过；可以看到拳头、脸颊以及它们之间的缝隙。拳风微微吹动她的头发和衣领。
主角嘴角露出极轻蔑的微笑，仿佛觉得对手太慢。表情应自然，不要夸张。

5.5–8.5s

攻击者左勾拳 -> 主角用前臂招架 -> 攻击者低位膝撞或短踢 -> 主角通过后脚小步后撤化解 -> 主角以短肘或拳头反击攻击者胸部或肩线。
每一个动作都必须有接触感。格挡必须切实改变攻击路径。受击侧必须根据受力方向在肩膀、头部、胸部和脚步上做出反应。
湿地上的脚步会有打滑，但不会失去控制。

8.5–11.5s
近身格斗升级。
攻击者更加凶猛，持续压制。主角试图控制攻击者的手臂并进行快速反击。
包括：
低角度看到攻击者准备旋风踢或强力侧踢；
主角先闪避一次危险的近身攻击；
随后两人短暂交锋，有腕部控制、肩部碰撞和肘部格挡。
摄像机围绕两人旋转半圈，保持面部、手部、脚部和地面反应清晰。
主角似乎仍占优势，但攻击者并未被压制；她正在等待重击机会。

11.5–13.0s
攻击者突然爆发，打出一记强力的后旋踢，目标是主角的胸部或上身中心。
此时使用短暂的慢动作和延长的低频撞击声。
攻击者的脚后跟或脚底清晰地击中主角上身，而非落空。
主角身体受冲击力驱动，从胸部开始，肩膀后倾，双脚离开湿地，地面溅起水花和灰尘。
撞击必须具有真实的重量感，而不是像无重力飞出。

13.0–15.0s
主角被踢飞向开头出现的深色轿车。
摄像机快速跟随她向后的方向。
她的背部和肩膀撞击车身和前挡风玻璃区域；挡风玻璃破碎，玻璃碎片四散，但没有血迹。
她重重地摔在车身或破碎的挡风玻璃上，身体像失去力量一样瘫软。
攻击者站在湿滑的街道上，保持强硬的格斗姿态，像胜利者一样冷冷地看着她。

最后一秒，摄像机不再强调攻击者，而是从攻击者的方向缓慢推向躺在受损车辆上的主角面部。
主角脸上带着雨水、疲惫、痛苦和不甘，仍保持 image1 的身份特征。攻击者在背景中保持轻微模糊。
结尾不应切黑，停在主角破碎但清醒的表情上。

title: FPV 建筑工地变形
description: 一个复杂的 FPV 无人机提示词，展示了现代建筑同步机械化的变形过程。
positivePrompt:
创建一个 15 秒超动态连续 FPV 建筑变形视频。保持同一座现代建筑、同一个施工现场，确保整个过程中的建筑结构和最终设计完全一致。整个施工现场表现得像一台巨大的同步“超级机器”，每一个动作都会机械化地触发下一个动作。

呈现好莱坞级别的写实施工动作，IMAX 规模，14mm 超广角，激进的变速特效，钢蓝色阴影，温暖的施工橙色高光，逼真的灰尘、火花、碎片、运动模糊和金属反射。一镜到底，无剪辑。

00:00–00:02 - 核心激活
摄像机穿过未完工的建筑，飞向一个巨大的旋转机械施工核心。液压臂突然伸出并锁定在中心结构上。强烈的金属撞击产生火花溅射到镜头上，瞬间激活整个工地。

00:02–00:04 - 起重机级联
多台塔吊开始完美同步旋转。它们的缆绳释放出巨大的钢框架，在空中摆动并精准锁定在建筑上。摄像机在移动的结构间穿梭，带来极具冲击力的近距离掠过感。

00:04–00:06 - 结构升起
液压施工平台同时启动。立柱向上延伸，水平梁自动滑入连接点。每一次锁定都会触发下一个结构部分，形成快速向上的机械波。

00:06–00:08 - 楼层冲刺
摄像机俯冲穿过建筑。巨大的楼层平台从两侧沿着工业轨道移动，逐层快速锁定到位。随着结构在摄像机周围升起，机械夹具在镜头后方迅速闭合。

00:08–00:10 - 旋转框架
摄像机冲出室外，进行快速垂直轨道飞行。整个结构框架像巨大的机械臂一样从地面向上旋转并锁定在建筑上。未完成的骨架迅速演变为最终的建筑轮廓。

00:10–00:12 - 外立面风暴
数百个白色弧形立面部分和蓝色反射玻璃面板从自动化安装平台发射。它们以同步波浪状飞向建筑，并完美地扣合在弧形外墙上。

00:12–00:13.5 - 玻璃锁定
摄像机沿着外立面疾驰，一块巨大的玻璃面板紧贴镜头移动。速度突然降至短暂的“子弹时间”。火花和灰尘几乎静止悬浮。面板旋转并以强烈的机械撞击声锁定在框架中。

00:13.5–00:15 - 最终机器释放
最后一次撞击同时激活了所有剩余的施工机制。屋顶元件、最终的玻璃幕墙和建筑细节迅速锁定到位。摄像机飞越屋顶，进行快速 180° 旋转，并向后拉远，呈现出建筑在城市上方完全竣工的宏伟景象。
originalPrompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-dynamic continuous FPV construction transformation. Keep one identical modern building, one identical construction site, exact same architecture and final design throughout. The entire construction site behaves like one enormous synchronized MEGA MACHINE, where every movement mechanically activates the next.

Photorealistic Hollywood construction action, IMAX scale, 14mm extreme wide-angle, aggressive speed ramps, steel-blue shadows, warm construction-orange highlights, realistic dust, sparks, debris, motion blur and metallic reflections. One uninterrupted FPV shot, no cuts.

00:00–00:02- CORE ACTIVATION
Camera flies through the unfinished building toward a massive rotating mechanical construction core. Hydraulic arms suddenly extend and lock into the central structure. A powerful metal impact sends sparks across the lens, triggering the entire site.

00:02–00:04-CRANE CASCADE
Multiple tower cranes begin rotating in perfect synchronization. Their cables release enormous steel frames that swing through the air and lock precisely onto the building. Camera races between the moving structures with extreme near-misses.

00:04–00:06-STRUCTURE RISE
Hydraulic construction platforms activate simultaneously. Columns extend upward while horizontal beams automatically slide into their connection points. Each lock triggers the next structural section, creating a rapid upward mechanical wave.

00:06–00:08- FLOOR RUSH
Camera dives through the building. Massive floor platforms travel along industrial rails from both sides, rapidly locking into place floor by floor. Mechanical clamps snap shut immediately behind the camera as the structure rises around it.

00:08–00:10- ROTATING FRAME
Camera bursts outside and performs a fast vertical orbit. Entire structural frames rotate upward from the ground like giant mechanical arms and lock into the building. The unfinished skeleton rapidly becomes the exact final silhouette.

00:10–00:12- FACADE STORM
Hundreds of white curved façade sections and blue reflective glass panels launch from automated installation platforms. They fly toward the building in synchronized waves and snap perfectly into position around the curved exterior.

00:12–00:13.5- GLASS LOCK
Camera races along the façade as one enormous glass panel moves directly beside the lens. Speed suddenly drops into brief bullet time. Sparks and dust float almost motionless. The panel rotates and locks into its frame with a powerful mechanical impact.

00:13.5–00:15- FINAL MACHINE RELEASE
The final impact activates every remaining construction mechanism at once. Rooftop elements, final glazing and architectural details rapidly lock into place. Camera shoots above the roof, performs a fast 180° rotation and pulls far backward into a monumental aerial reveal of the fully completed building above the city

17–22s

22–26s

26–28s

Shelldon：“感谢您乘坐 Snail Express。”

片名卡：黑屏。粗体彩色字母“THE SNAIL EXPRESS”出现，旁边飘动着一件小小的叶子斗篷。伴随一声轻柔的派对哨声。

positivePrompt: 创作一段 30 秒、1080p 超写实的手持家庭录像风格短片，开头呈现令人恐惧的灵异事件，随后逐渐转变为一段荒诞而温馨的浪漫蒙太奇。整体风格：画面必须看起来像真实的消费级摄像机拍摄，而非精致的电影大片。采用写实的手持拍摄美学：自然的镜头抖动、不完美的构图、偶尔的自动对焦延迟、轻微的曝光变化、柔和的数字细节、轻微的运动模糊、淡淡的噪点、真实的室内光线以及可信的人类反应。前半部分应营造出夜晚在客厅中偶然捕捉到的恐怖录像感。后半部分应转变为一系列节奏明快但清晰的甜蜜日常瞬间，且始终保持写实感。主要角色：一群在夜晚客厅看电视的普通年轻人。在惊吓过后，一名年轻男子留在画面中心。他表现冷静，略显困惑，但心地善良。一个类似幽灵的年轻女子从电视中爬出。她皮肤苍白，留着湿漉漉的长黑发，表情疲惫而诡异，穿着简单的白色连衣裙或睡袍。她起初看起来令人不安，但依然真实且具有人类特征——不恐怖、不血腥、不腐烂。随着视频推进，她应保持同一人的形象，只是逐渐变得干净、清爽、体面。不要将她变成完全不同的人。重要基调：开头紧张恐怖，随后转为荒诞的善意与甜蜜的幽默。幽默感源于对比：一个恐怖的幽灵进入房间，而男子的反应却像是她只是非常需要帮助和自我护理。时间轴：00:00–00:05 —— 客厅 / 恐怖开场：几个朋友在昏暗的客厅里看老式电视播放的恐怖片。电视闪烁不定，房间主要靠电视光和一盏微弱的灯照明。突然，一个留着湿长黑发的苍白幽灵女孩从电视里爬进房间。人们惊慌失措，尖叫着逃跑。手持摄像机剧烈晃动，难以捕捉动作。00:05–00:07 —— 男子留下：一名年轻男子留在房间里，震惊地盯着她。他没有尖叫，而是露出关切的神情，说类似这样的话：“噢不……我们需要解决这个问题。”幽灵女孩停下来，显得很困惑。00:07–00:11 —— 快速清理 / 改造开始：节奏快但清晰的蒙太奇。他示意她去清理一下。展示简短的写实片段：她尴尬地站在浴室门口、刷牙、洗漱/淋浴蒸汽/冲洗头发、他递给她一条毛巾、她的头发看起来更干净且不再凌乱。保持动作简单且视觉清晰。不要让浴室动作过于复杂。00:11–00:15 —— 准备就绪：更多快速改造瞬间：他帮她擦干或轻轻梳理头发，她现在看起来更整洁，依然苍白，依然是同一个幽灵女孩，化了淡妆或外观更整洁，穿着更干净的休闲装或她原装束的改进版。她依然显得有些怪异和面无表情，只是不再那么恐怖。00:15–00:23 —— 温馨蒙太奇：一段甜蜜、幽默的两人公共场合相处蒙太奇：在公园散步、坐在长椅上、吃冰淇淋或分享零食、自拍、喂鸟或鸭子、尴尬地大笑，有一个她尝试模仿人类正常行为的小可爱瞬间。一切都应感觉温暖、略带荒诞，但依然真实且接地气。00:23–00:27 —— 求婚：在一个简单、真诚的户外时刻，男子向她求婚。他展示了一枚戒指。她看起来很惊讶，随后露出一抹安静的微笑并接受了。保持甜蜜，不要夸张。00:27–00:30 —— 婚礼结局：切换到小型婚礼仪式。他们穿着婚礼礼服，站在一起，宾客们微笑着鼓掌。幽灵女孩看起来冷静而美丽，但仍带有一种迷人的诡异感。作为最后一个镜头，加入一个小幽默：背景中的电视屏幕闪烁了一下，她瞥了一眼。到此结束。视觉/物理真实性：全程保持可信的解剖结构和动作。没有断肢、没有多余的手指、没有漂浮物体、没有瞬移、没有衣服消失、没有突然的身份改变。保持幽灵女孩的面部和身份在各场景间的一致性。保持男子的身份一致。所有互动必须看起来在物理上是合理的。摄像机/剪辑：短片应感觉像真实的录像，带有剪辑感，而非精致的电影预告片。开头的客厅惊吓应感觉原始且混乱。蒙太奇可以更快，但每个镜头都必须清晰易读。不要使用慢动作。不要使用电影级的摇臂镜头、无人机镜头或光鲜的商业灯光。音频：仅使用自然的场景音频：电视闪烁声/房间环境音、惊吓反应、浴室环境音、户外公园环境音、婚礼环境音。无需戏剧性的配乐。无需旁白。重要限制：无血腥、无流血、无身体恐怖、无图形暴力、无怪诞的面部扭曲、屏幕上无受版权保护的标志或可识别的电影片段。不要让幽灵女孩卡通化。不要让浪漫情节显得嘲讽或残忍。保持幽默感温暖、怪异且出人意料地温馨。最终感受：最终效果应像是一段恐怖的伪纪录片设置，转变成一个异常甜蜜的爱情故事。它应该在后半部分变得有趣、令人难忘、看起来真实且情感温暖。
originalPrompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic handheld home-video style clip that begins like a frightening paranormal incident and gradually turns into a bizarre wholesome romantic montage. OVERALL STYLE The footage must look like real consumer-camera video, not polished cinema. Use a realistic handheld recording aesthetic: natural hand shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus delay, slight exposure shifts, soft digital detail, mild motion blur, faint noise, realistic indoor lighting, and believable human reactions. The first part should feel like spontaneous scary footage captured in a living room at night. The later part should become a quick but clear montage of sweet everyday moments, still grounded in realism. MAIN CHARACTERS A group of ordinary young adults watching TV in a living room at night. One young man stays central after the scare. He is calm, slightly confused, but kind. A creepy ghost-like young woman emerges from the TV. She has very pale skin, long wet black hair, a tired eerie expression, and a simple white dress or nightgown. She should look unsettling at first, but still human and realistic — not monstrous, not gory, not decomposed. As the video continues, she should remain the exact same woman, only gradually becoming cleaner, fresher, and more presentable. Do not transform her into a completely different person. IMPORTANT TONE Start tense and scary. Then switch into absurd kindness and sweet humor. The humor should come from the contrast between: a terrifying ghost entering the room, and a guy reacting like she just badly needs help and self-care. TIMELINE 00:00–00:05 — LIVING ROOM / HORROR START A few friends are sitting in a dim living room at night watching a scary movie on an old television. The TV is flickering. The room is lit mostly by the TV glow and a weak lamp. Suddenly, a creepy pale ghost girl with long wet black hair starts crawling out of the television into the room. The people panic, scream, and run away in fear. The handheld camera shakes hard and struggles to keep the action framed. 00:05–00:07 — THE GUY STAYS One young man remains in the room, staring at her in shock. Instead of screaming, he looks concerned and says something like: “Oh no… we need to fix this.” The ghost girl pauses and looks confused. 00:07–00:11 — QUICK CLEANUP / MAKEOVER START Fast but readable montage. He gestures for her to go clean up. Show short realistic clips of: her standing awkwardly in a bathroom doorway, brushing her teeth, washing up / shower steam / rinsing her hair, him handing her a towel, her hair looking cleaner and less messy. Keep this simple and visually clear. Do not overcomplicate the bathroom actions. 00:11–00:15 — GETTING READY More quick makeover moments: he helps dry or gently brush her hair, she now looks neater, still pale, still clearly the same ghost girl, very light makeup or a tidier appearance, a cleaner casual outfit or a more presentable version of her original look. She should still feel slightly strange and deadpan, just less terrifying. 00:15–00:23 — WHOLESOME MONTAGE A sweet, funny montage of them spending time together in public: walking through a park, sitting on a bench, eating ice cream or sharing a snack, taking a selfie, feeding birds or ducks, laughing awkwardly, one small cute moment where she tries to imitate normal human behavior. Everything should feel warm, a little absurd, but still realistic and grounded. 00:23–00:27 — PROPOSAL In a simple, heartfelt outdoor moment, the guy proposes to her. He shows a ring. She looks surprised, then gives a small quiet smile and accepts. Keep it sweet, not exaggerated. 00:27–00:30 — WEDDING ENDING Cut to a small wedding ceremony. They are dressed for a wedding, standing together while guests smile and clap. The ghost girl looks calm and beautiful but still slightly eerie in a charming way. For the final beat, add one subtle joke: a nearby TV screen flickers in the background, and she glances at it for a second. End there. VISUAL / PHYSICAL REALISM Maintain believable anatomy and motion throughout. No broken limbs, no extra fingers, no floating objects, no teleporting, no disappearing clothing, no sudden identity changes. Keep the ghost girl’s face and identity consistent from scene to scene. Keep the man’s identity consistent as well. All interactions must look physically plausible. CAMERA / EDITING The clip should feel like a real recorded video with cuts, not a polished movie trailer. The opening living room scare should feel especially raw and chaotic. The montage can be faster, but each shot must still be readable and visually clean. Do not use slow motion. Do not use cinematic crane shots, drone shots, or glossy commercial lighting. AUDIO Use only natural scene audio: TV flicker / room ambience, frightened reactions, bathroom ambience, outdoor park ambience, wedding ambience. No dramatic score is necessary. No narration. IMPORTANT RESTRICTIONS No gore No blood No body horror No graphic violence No grotesque facial distortions No copyrighted logos or recognizable movie footage on-screen Do not make the ghost girl cartoonish Do not make the romance mocking or cruel Keep the humor warm, weird, and unexpectedly wholesome FINAL FEEL The final result should feel like: a terrifying found-footage setup that turns into a strangely sweet love story. It should be funny, memorable, realistic-looking, and emotionally warm in the second half.

场景 1：青衣女子从左前方快速切入，前脚蹬地，后脚发力，斜向跨越石板路，动作轻盈而有力。空中转腰，剑刃由低向高刺向白衣女子肩部；后者以小碎步侧滑避开锋芒，身体微后仰，衣袂飘动，顺势用剑身沿脊椎方向拨开来剑。青衣女子落地后以前脚为轴继续旋转，横向扫剑；白衣女子立即下蹲，屈膝后仰避开横扫，同时剑尖由低位点向对方落点。摄像机从斜前方高速追踪，保持完整中景，跳跃时轻微上升，闪避时下沉，捕捉空中刺击、格挡、落地旋转及低位点刺的全过程。

title: 2D 动画混合 POV
category: 电影级运镜与基础机位
crossCategories: 电影级运镜与基础机位
description: 一个为 Seedance 2.5 设计的独特混合提示词，将真人 POV 镜头与城市背景下的手绘 2D 动画混乱感相结合。
positivePrompt:
在一个真人实拍与手绘 2D 动画混合的原创世界中的 POV 序列。整个场景以第一人称视角拍摄，包含平滑的手持运镜、快速平移和灵动的重新构图。真实环境采用自然光和逼真的阴影；动画角色采用粗犷的墨水轮廓、平涂色彩、富有弹性的动作和极具表现力的卡通节奏。复古城市喜剧风格，完全原创设计，无任何可识别角色，无工作室参考。

一条虚构的复古城市街道通向一个色彩缤纷的娱乐大厅，随后进入狭窄的后台走廊和室外小巷。

0-5 秒：POV 穿过热闹的街道。真实的行人在正常行走，而小巧抽象的卡通生物在标志牌之间跳跃，穿过门口并留下手绘的动态轨迹。

5-10 秒：POV 进入大厅。一个微小的动画服务员端着摇晃的饮料在真实的柜台上滑行，旋转一圈，向镜头挥手，然后消失在幕布后。

10-16 秒：POV 转向舞台上的真人表演者，动画音乐家在他们周围演奏。一件卡通乐器向镜头方向拉伸，卷成螺旋状，然后轻快地弹回原位。

16-22 秒：POV 后退，顽皮的动画混乱在房间内蔓延：绘制的纸片形状漂浮着，一个卡通角色被压扁在门下，另一个留下一团素描星星。真实的人们保持完全严肃的状态。

22-27 秒：POV 在走廊中快速移动，一个小巧的动画向导在镜头旁奔跑，并用英语说道：“Keep moving. The drawings are improvising again.”（继续走，这些画又在即兴发挥了。）

27-30 秒：POV 进入小巷。一个巨大的充气卡通道具从镜头前晃过，无害地撞在垃圾桶上，并向空中喷射出五彩缤纷的绘制星星。以一个顽皮的定格画面结束。
originalPrompt:
POV sequence in an original live-action and hand-drawn 2D animation hybrid world. The entire scene is filmed from first-person perspective with smooth handheld movement, quick pans and playful reframing. Real environments use natural lighting and realistic shadows; animated characters use bold ink outlines, flat colors, elastic motion and expressive cartoon timing. Retro urban comedy, fully original design, no recognizable characters, no studio references.

A fictional old-fashioned city street leading into a colorful entertainment hall, then a narrow backstage corridor and exterior alley.

0-5s: POV moves through a lively street. Real pedestrians walk normally while small abstract cartoon creatures bounce between signs, stretch across doorways and leave hand-drawn motion trails.

5-10s: POV enters the hall. A tiny animated server slides across a real counter carrying wobbling drinks, spins once, waves at camera and disappears behind a curtain.

10-16s: POV turns toward a live performer on stage while animated musicians play around them. One cartoon instrument stretches toward the lens, curls into a spiral, then snaps gently back into place.

16-22s: POV backs away as playful animated chaos spreads through the room: drawn paper shapes float, a cartoon character flattens under a door, another leaves a cloud of sketched stars. Real people remain completely serious.

22-27s: POV moves quickly down the corridor while a small animated guide runs beside camera and says in English: “Keep moving. The drawings are improvising again.”

27-30s: POV exits into the alley. A huge inflatable cartoon prop swings past the lens, bounces harmlessly off a trash bin and launches colorful drawn stars into the air. End on a playful freeze-frame.
